steps.body: Toronto and East York Community Council
steps.text: Sent to City Council without recommendations.

2025.NY20.1.text: North York Community Council denied the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree at 425 Manor Road East. City Council gave North York Community Council the authority to decide, so this decision is final.
2025.NY20.1.plainTitle: Request to cut down a tree at 425 Manor Rd E was denied
2025.NY20.1.outcome: North York Community Council denied the permit to remove the tree, as City staff recommended. The tree stays.

2026.NY29.1.text: North York Community Council approved the permit to remove one privately owned tree at 10 Glencairn Avenue and required five replacement trees. City Council gave North York Community Council the authority to decide, so this decision is final.
2026.NY29.1.plainTitle: Tree at 10 Glencairn Ave can be cut down, 5 new trees required
2026.NY29.1.outcome: City staff recommended denying the permit, but North York Community Council approved it and required 5 replacement trees (planted or paid for).
